passive.name: Gittarackur
passive.description: Illumi drives needles into his own face to reshape it, disguising himself as an allied champion. The disguise breaks when he deals or takes damage.

disguise.form: Any allied champion of his choice
disguise.breaks: When Illumi deals or takes damage

h1.name: Instinct to Flee
h1.description: Illumi throws a needle in a line. The first enemy champion hit has the urge to run planted in their mind and flees from Illumi in terror.

h2.name: Command Pin
h2.description: Illumi throws a needle in a line. The first enemy champion hit loses their will and walks helplessly towards him.

h3.name: Needle People
h3.description: Illumi rains needles over an area. Minions and monsters struck become his puppets and fight for him for a few seconds; enemy champions caught take damage.

h4.name: Puppet Rain
h4.description: Illumi sends a wide wall of needles sweeping forward. Enemy champions struck become his puppets for a short time, attacking the nearest of their own allies.

puppet.effect: They attack the nearest of their own allies with bonus attack speed

effects.damage: None of its own: the damage is dealt by the victims' allies

lore:
Illumi Zoldyck is the eldest son of Silva and Kikyo Zoldyck, raised from birth in the family trade of assassination and one of its most accomplished killers. Alongside his father he trained his younger brother Killua to become an elite assassin, and under Silva's orders he planted a Nen needle in Killua's brain that forced him to flee from any fight he was not certain to win. Sent to watch over Killua when he ran away from home, Illumi entered the Hunter Exam disguised as Gittarackur and later became a reluctant partner of Hisoka, even joining the Phantom Troupe on his commission. Cold and self-serving, he holds a twisted, possessive love for his family, above all for Killua.

Illumi is a Manipulator who fights with long Nen-charged needles. Driven into a victim's body, they turn people into obedient puppets, and driven into his own face, they let him reshape his features into another person entirely. He hurls them with lethal precision and controls the battlefield more than he fights in it. Expressionless and speaking in an oddly cheerful, absent tone, he treats murder as a job and people as tools.
